remarks: Welcome to this bright and cheerful rental home located in the highly sought-after Shippan area of Stamford. Freshly painted throughout, including refreshed kitchen cabinets and new stainless steel appliances! (New photos coming!) This well maintained, inviting home offers a comfortable coastal lifestyle just a short walk to the beach. Sun-filled interiors create a warm and welcoming atmosphere, while outdoor furniture is included for easy enjoyment of the outdoor spaces. An additional upper-level deck with beautiful water views provides the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. A wonderful opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most desirable waterfront neighborhoods.
